svg.title: Four places where a derivative does not exist
svg.desc: Four small graphs. A corner: y = |x| + 0.5, a V shape with slope minus 1 on the left of 0 and 1 on the right. A cusp: y = x to the two-thirds, a sharp point at the origin where the slopes become infinitely steep in opposite directions. A vertical tangent: y = cube root of (x minus 1), which passes through (1, 0) with a vertical tangent line x = 1, drawn dashed. A jump: a line that ends with a closed dot at (1, 1.5) and restarts with an open dot at (1, 0). The first three are continuous but not differentiable at the marked point; the jump is not continuous, so it is not differentiable either.
svg.text: slopes −1 on the left, 1 on the right
slopes → −∞ on the left, +∞ on the right
